payload.answer: Obsolete question (owner 2026-11-21 via Miu, checked by the supervisor): both parts of this item are already done. Config is YAML since 6c041c302 (2026-10-25): .fgos/config.yaml holds the config, .fgos/config.json is a pointer, src/setup/shared-config-file.mjs no longer exists and reads go through src/config/facade.mjs. The runner reads its config over the config door (loadRunnerConfigForDir in src/runner/dispatch/config.mjs); the hand-rolled fs/JSON reads in dispatch.mjs are gone. Residue is comments naming config.json only.
